verdict.rationale: For a UI framework, the closest equivalent of official SDKs is the framework package plus its first-party libraries. Vue ships as an official npm package and maintains an official router (Vue Router) and state store (Pinia, formerly Vuex), and community users confirm these work well out of the box with official scaffolding tooling. Community reports describe TypeScript support as mediocre, which weakens the typed build-against experience. Missing for 10: SDK-style API reference or typed client documentation in the evidence, documented strong TypeScript typings, and any AI- or agent-oriented SDK guidance beyond the llms.txt index.
